title: The HA Green's owner and every repo that loads it adopt the shared-machine convention
why: Part 2 of c140 (shared machine names one owner), from your HA Green problem, Oct 27 13:15 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2RSWZr4XsNtpstx8kVFBn66).

The live fixes (map-fetch ban, freeze-hold rule, push add-on retries, degen load cuts) stay with the home and degen sessions already on them. c140 merged in batch 6 (main 599dd58b). Ruling, Oct 28 02:31 CDT (shiv, waiting page item 2, a): yes to the one plan; the other-repo part lands through PRs in each repo. His caution: every repo is paused, but not all their work has merged to main, so each lane reads the repo's open branches and PRs first.
